title: Generating the Wild: Individual-Consistent Image-to-Video Generation for Wildlife
title_zh: 生成野生世界：面向野生动物个体的图像到视频一致性生成

paragraphs.en: Individual-level wildlife identification often suffers from data scarcity, as varying observations of the same animal under diverse poses, viewpoints, and motions are rarely available. Image-to-video (I2V) generation offers a promising way to mitigate this limitation by synthesizing additional observations from a single reference image. However, existing I2V models mainly emphasize global layout, semantics, and motion, and therefore often fail to preserve fine-grained local appearance cues that distinguish one wildlife individual from another, such as fur texture, stripe boundaries, spot configurations, and contour transitions. We observe that these identity-critical cues are closely related to high-frequency information, which is essential for distinguishing individuals. To address this challenge, we propose WildIcon , a high-frequency-guided I2V framework for wildlife individual consistency. Specifically, WildIcon introduces a frequency-aware identity encoding branch that extracts individual-specific high-frequency cues from the reference image. Combined with isolated foreground information, the resulting identity tokens are then injected into cross-attention blocks as identity conditioning. Building on a frozen backbone with lightweight identity adaptation, WildIcon preserves fine-grained identity cues visible in the reference image while retaining the motion controllability and semantic fidelity of the base I2V model. In addition, to support the training and evaluation of wildlife individual-consistent I2V, we construct WildlifeVid , a wildlife-centric video dataset with high-quality, temporally coherent clips and individual-level identity labels. Experiments on I2V generation and downstream animal re-identification (ReID) show that WildIcon achieves stronger individual consistency than existing baselines, and that its filtered outputs can serve as useful candidate training augmentations for downstream ReID.

paragraphs.en: Wildlife conservation is essential for maintaining ecological balance, protecting endangered habitats, and sustaining essential ecosystem services [ 13 ; 63 ] . A key requirement in these efforts is individual-level identification for monitoring population dynamics, movement patterns, and individual condition in a scalable and non-invasive way [ 1 ; 66 ] . However, reliable wildlife identification remains fundamentally constrained by data scarcity, since repeated observations of the same individual under diverse poses, viewpoints, and environmental conditions are often unavailable [ 44 ; 62 ; 26 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 野生动物保护对于维持生态平衡、保护濒危栖息地以及维系关键的生态系统服务至关重要 [ 13 ; 63 ] 。 这些工作的一项关键要求是，以可扩展且无侵入的方式对个体进行识别，以便监测种群动态、活动模式及个体状况 [ 1 ; 66 ] 。 然而，可靠的野生动物识别仍然受到数据稀缺的根本性限制，因为通常无法获得同一个体在不同姿态、视角和环境条件下多次观测的数据 [ 44 ; 62 ; 26 ] 。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate this limitation, prior work has explored data enrichment strategies, including data augmentation techniques ( e.g., cropping, flipping, and color jittering) [ 46 ; 4 ] and synthetic image generation [ 40 ] . While conventional data augmentations can improve model robustness against moderate changes in scale, illumination and color, they remain limited to transformations of already observed samples and cannot synthesize genuinely new poses or complex out-of-plane viewpoint changes [ 22 ; 73 ; 37 ] . Image generation models can produce more diverse appearances and poses, but they operate on isolated frames without explicit temporal or geometric constraints, and therefore often fail to preserve subject identity under large viewpoint changes [ 75 ; 16 ; 49 ; 70 ] . Image-to-video (I2V) generation is therefore a more promising direction: given a reference image, it can synthesize additional observations of the same individual under new motions, poses, and views [ 19 ; 41 ; 25 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为缓解这一局限性，先前的研究探索了数据增强策略，包括数据增强技术（例如裁剪、翻转和颜色抖动）[46; 4] 以及合成图像生成 [40]。 虽然传统的数据增强方法能够提升模型对尺度、光照和颜色中等程度变化的鲁棒性，但它们仍局限于对已有观测样本的变换，无法合成真正全新的姿态或复杂的出平面视角变化 [22; 73; 37]。 图像生成模型能够产生更多样化的外观和姿态，但它们是在没有明确时间或几何约束的孤立帧上运行的，因此常常无法在较大的视角变化下保持主体身份的一致性 [75; 16; 49; 70]。 因此，图像到视频（I2V）生成是一个更有前景的方向：给定一张参考图像，它能够合成同一主体在新动作、姿态和视角下的额外观测结果 [19; 41; 25]。

paragraphs.en: Despite this promise, existing I2V models are not designed for individual consistency in wildlife. Although they can generate realistic motion and preserve coarse subject appearance, maintaining consistency with the reference animal across frames requires preserving subtle local appearance cues that remain discriminative under changes in pose, viewpoint, and background. In wildlife, these cues often take the form of fine-grained visual patterns, such as fur or scale texture, stripe boundaries, spot configurations, and contour transitions [ 62 ; 21 ] . To better understand which visual information is most important for distinguishing individuals, we analyze the role of frequency components in wildlife identity. As shown in Figure 1 , these fine-grained patterns are more closely related to high-frequency image information, which captures rapid spatial changes and fine visual structures [ 28 ; 20 ] . In contrast, low-frequency views mainly retain global content while suppressing many identity-critical details. This observation reveals a mismatch between the requirements of wildlife identity preservation and the modeling priorities of modern I2V models: while they are effective at modeling global layout, semantic content and temporal motion, they do not explicitly preserve the sparse local high-frequency details critical for wildlife identity [ 68 ] . As a result, they may generate visually plausible videos while still drifting in identity-critical appearance from one individual to another.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管有这一承诺，现有的 I2V 模型并未针对野生动物的个体一致性进行设计。 虽然它们能够生成逼真的运动并保留主体的大致外观，但要确保各帧中与参考动物的一致性，就需要保留那些在姿态、视角和背景变化下仍能具有区分度的细微局部外观特征。 在野生动物中，这些特征通常表现为精细的视觉模式，例如毛发或鳞片纹理、条纹边界、斑点分布以及轮廓过渡 [ 62 ; 21 ] 。 为了更好地理解哪些视觉信息对于区分个体最为重要，我们分析了频率成分在野生动物身份识别中的作用。 如图 1 所示，这些精细模式与高频图像信息更为相关，后者能够捕捉快速的空间变化和精细的视觉结构 [ 28 ; 20 ] 。 相比之下，低频视图主要保留全局内容，同时抑制了许多对身份识别至关重要的细节。 这一观察揭示了野生动物身份保持的需求与现代 I2V 模型的建模重点之间的不匹配：尽管这些模型在模拟全局布局、语义内容和时间运动方面效果显著，但它们并未明确保留对野生动物身份至关重要的稀疏局部高频细节 [ 68 ] 。 因此，它们虽然可能生成视觉上令人信服的视频，但在个体间的关键外观特征上仍可能出现漂移。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this observation, we propose WildIcon (Sec. 4 ), a high-frequency-guided I2V framework tailored to wildlife individual consistency. WildIcon introduces a frequency-aware identity encoding branch that explicitly extracts foreground-filtered high-frequency cues from the reference image and encodes them together with foreground appearance information into identity tokens for identity-aware conditioning. These identity tokens are injected into selected cross-attention layers, enabling I2V models to preserve fine-grained individual identity, while the remaining blocks are kept frozen to retain the inherent motion controllability and semantic fidelity of the pretrained backbone. To enable training and evaluation, we further construct WildlifeVid , a wildlife-centric video dataset curated through a scalable pipeline (Sec. 3 ) that provides high-quality, temporally coherent clips and individual identity labels under realistic variation in viewpoint, motion, illumination and background. Together, WildIcon and WildlifeVid provide a modeling and data foundation for wildlife individual-consistent I2V generation.

paragraphs.en: We validate this framework on both wildlife I2V generation and downstream animal ReID. Experiments show that WildIcon outperforms existing baselines in individual consistency and downstream animal ReID performance by producing reliable, identity-aware synthetic videos. In summary, our main contributions are: (1) We construct WildlifeVid, a wildlife-centric video dataset comprising single-subject wildlife clips with identity labels and standardized prompts for training and evaluating individual-consistent I2V models. (2) We propose WildIcon, a high-frequency-guided I2V framework that makes sparse wildlife identity patterns explicit conditioning signals, enabling I2V models to preserve individual-specific local cues while maintaining motion controllability and semantic fidelity. (3) We demonstrate that wildlife individual-consistent I2V benefits downstream animal ReID: by converting limited real observations into additional individual-consistent training samples, WildIcon helps mitigate the data scarcity that limits individual-level wildlife identification.

paragraphs.en: Image-to-video generation. Image-to-video (I2V) generation extends video foundation models by conditioning generation on a reference image and, optionally, a text prompt. Recent methods have explored a variety of conditioning strategies to inject visual guidance into pretrained video generators. For example, DynamiCrafter [ 64 ] incorporates image embeddings through cross-attention, while Stable Video Diffusion [ 2 ] and CogVideoX [ 67 ] concatenate conditional latents with noisy video latents. Wan [ 54 ] further adopts mask-guided conditioning and decoupled cross-attention to support high-quality I2V generation. While these methods improve controllability over text-only generation, maintaining fine-grained individual consistency remains challenging. For wildlife, identity cues are often sparse and closely tied to high-frequency structures, coarse reference-image conditioning is insufficient for individual consistency. Although DiT-based I2V backbones model global structure and motion well, they lack explicit mechanisms for preserving local identity-critical details, leading to appearance drift in generated wildlife videos.
paragraphs.zh: 图像到视频生成。 图像到视频（I2V）生成通过以参考图像和可选的文本提示作为条件，扩展了视频基础模型。 近期的方法探索了多种条件策略，以将视觉引导注入预训练的视频生成器中。 例如，DynamiCrafter [ 64 ] 通过交叉注意力整合图像嵌入，而 Stable Video Diffusion [ 2 ] 和 CogVideoX [ 67 ] 则将条件潜在变量与含噪视频潜在变量进行拼接。 Wan [ 54 ] 进一步采用了掩码引导的条件机制和解耦交叉注意力，以支持高质量的 I2V 生成。 尽管这些方法相比仅基于文本的生成提升了可控性，但保持精细的个体一致性仍然具有挑战性。 对于野生动物而言，身份特征通常稀疏且与高频结构紧密相关，因此粗略的参考图像条件设置不足以维持个体一致性。 虽然基于 DiT 的 I2V 主干模型能够很好地建模全局结构和运动，但它们缺乏明确机制来保留局部关键身份细节，导致生成的野生动物视频出现外观漂移。

paragraphs.en: Identity-preserving video generation. Beyond general I2V generation, recent work has studied subject-consistent and identity-preserving video generation, where the goal is to maintain a reference subject across generated frames while following text instructions. Subject-driven methods improve consistency through reference-image injection or cross-modal text-image-video alignment [ 58 ; 17 ; 61 ; 31 ] , while human-centered identity-preserving methods use facial representations, landmarks, or frequency-decomposed facial cues to preserve person identity [ 68 ; 71 ; 51 ] . Their conditioning mechanisms are mainly designed for general subject appearance or human facial identity, and therefore do not directly transfer to wildlife, where identity is often determined by sparse high-frequency patterns such as texture, stripes, spots, and contour transitions. WildIcon instead conditions generation on foreground-filtered high-frequency cues to better maintain fine-grained identity-relevant patterns visible in the reference.

paragraphs.en: Wildlife individual identity modeling. High-frequency information captures rapid spatial changes and fine visual structures, which in wildlife often correspond to individual-discriminative cues such as fur or scale texture, stripe boundaries, spot configurations, and contour details. AdaFreq [ 21 ] supports this view by showing that high-frequency cues provide an effective cross-species representation for wildlife ReID. While some recent generative efforts ( e.g. , Syn-Tiger-360 [ 49 ] ) further show that preserving cross-view biometric topologies improves downstream ReID, generalizable identity-preserving I2V generation for diverse wildlife remains underexplored. WildIcon extends wildlife identity modeling to this generative setting by using foreground-filtered high-frequency cues as conditioning signals for maintaining reference-supported individual appearance over time.
paragraphs.zh: 野生动物个体身份建模。 高频信息能够捕捉快速的空间变化与精细的视觉结构，而在野生动物中，这些信息通常对应于用于区分个体的特征，例如毛发或鳞片的纹理、条纹边界、斑点的排列以及轮廓细节。 AdaFreq [ 21 ] 通过证明高频特征为野生动物跨物种重识别（ReID）提供了有效的表示方式，支持了这一观点。 尽管近期的一些生成式研究（例如 Syn-Tiger-360 [ 49 ] ）进一步表明，保留跨视角的生物特征拓扑结构能够提升下游的重识别效果，但针对多样化野生动物的、具备泛化能力的身份保留图像到视频（I2V）生成技术仍未被充分探索。 WildIcon 通过将前景过滤后的高频特征用作条件信号，用于在时间维度上维持参考支持的个体外观，从而将野生动物身份建模扩展到了这一生成式场景之中。

paragraphs.en: Developing wildlife individual-consistent I2V models requires wildlife videos with individual-level identity annotations, because these labels indicate which clips correspond to the same wildlife individual and support learning the visual cues that distinguish it from others of the same species. However, existing wildlife video datasets are primarily annotated for species, action, or behavior recognition, providing limited support for individual identity modeling. To address this gap, we present WildlifeVid, a wildlife-centric video dataset that provides individual identity labels, curated via a scalable pipeline for wildlife-consistent I2V generation. WildlifeVid is constructed by curating and re-annotating clips from four publicly accessible wildlife video sources: Animal-in-Motion (AiM) [ 72 ] , AnimalKingdom [ 33 ] , MammalNet [ 6 ] , and LoTE-Animal [ 30 ] . paragraphs.en: Animal-centric clip extraction. Raw wildlife videos often contain shot changes, frames without a visible animal, or multiple animals in the same view, making them unsuitable for identity annotation. We therefore first split each source video into candidate clips based on shot changes using PySceneDetect [ 3 ] , which detects large weighted average pixel changes across adjacent frames. We then remove clips that do not clearly show the target species using CLIP-based species filtering [ 38 ; 12 ] . Finally, we enforce a strict single-subject constraint on the remaining clips by retaining only clips with exactly one detected animal throughout the clip and discarding clips with zero or multiple detected animals.
paragraphs.zh: 以动物为中心的片段提取。 原始野生动物视频通常包含镜头切换、没有可见动物的帧，或同一画面中出现多个动物，因此不适合用于身份标注。 因此，我们首先使用 PySceneDetect [ 3 ] 根据镜头切换将每个源视频分割为候选片段，该工具能够检测相邻帧之间加权平均像素值的大幅变化。 接着，我们利用基于 CLIP 的物种过滤方法 [ 38 ; 12 ] 移除未能清晰展示目标物种的片段。 最后，我们对剩余的片段施加严格的单一主体约束：仅保留整个片段中恰好检测到一个动物的片段，并丢弃未检测到动物或检测到多个动物的片段。

paragraphs.en: Visibility and temporal stability filtering. After obtaining candidate single-subject clips, we further filter them to ensure that each clip can be assigned a reliable individual identity label. We sample frames from each candidate clip and examine the detected wildlife individual over time. paragraphs.en: In this section, we propose WildIcon , a high-frequency-guided I2V framework for individual-consistent wildlife generation. Given a reference image I ref I_{\mathrm{ref}} of a known wildlife individual and a text prompt y y describing the desired motion or scene context, our goal is to generate a video V = { I t } t = 1 T V=\{I_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} consisting of T T frames that remains temporally coherent, follows the prompt, and preserves the individual’s fine-grained identity throughout the sequence. As illustrated in Figure 3 , WildIcon consists of a frequency-aware identity encoder, an identity-conditioning module, and a DiT-based video backbone. Built on Wan2.2, WildIcon strengthens identity preservation by extracting foreground-filtered high-frequency cues from the reference image and injecting the resulting identity tokens into selected DiT blocks.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation metrics. An ideal I2V generator should not only align with the text prompt but also preserve the reference subject throughout the generated video. Accurately quantifying appearance drift is important for evaluating fine-grained video generation. Therefore, we evaluate our method using VBench-based metrics [ 14 ; 15 ] together with complementary video-generation metrics. (1) I2V Subject: Cosine similarity between DINO [ 48 ] features of the input image and the generated frames, measuring how well the reference subject is preserved in the generated video. (2) I2V Background: DreamSim [ 11 ] feature similarity between the input image and generated frames, assessing the visual consistency of the scene/background. (3) Subject Consistency: Average cosine similarity of DINO features across consecutive frames, evaluating subject appearance consistency throughout the video. (4) Text Relevance: We use CLIPScore [ 12 ] to measure the similarity between the generated videos and the input prompts. (5) Motion Smoothness: Motion prior score derived from a video frame interpolation model [ 27 ] , assessing whether the generated motion remains smooth. (6) FVD: Fréchet Video Distance [ 52 ] measures the distributional distance between generated and real videos in the feature space of a pretrained video recognition network. Lower FVD indicates better overall spatio-temporal realism.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。 理想的 I2V 生成器不仅应与文本提示对齐，还应在整个生成的视频中保留参考主体。 准确量化外观漂移对于评估细粒度视频生成至关重要。 因此，我们使用基于 VBench 的指标 [ 14 ; 15 ] 以及补充的视频生成指标来评估我们的方法。 (1) I2V 主体：输入图像与生成帧之间的 DINO [ 48 ] 特征的余弦相似度，用于衡量参考主体在生成视频中的保留程度。 (2) I2V 背景：输入图像与生成帧之间的 DreamSim [ 11 ] 特征相似度，用于评估场景/背景的视觉一致性。 (3) 主体一致性：连续帧之间 DINO 特征的平均余弦相似度，用于评估主体在整个视频中的外观一致性。 (4) 文本相关性：我们使用 CLIPScore [ 12 ] 来衡量生成视频与输入提示之间的相似度。 (5) 运动平滑度：由视频帧插值模型 [ 27 ] 得出的运动先验分数，用于评估生成的运动是否保持平滑。 (6) FVD：Fréchet 视频距离 [ 52 ] 衡量生成视频与真实视频在预训练视频识别网络的特征空间中的分布距离。 FVD 值越低，表示整体的时空真实性越高。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark. To evaluate whether a generator can preserve the identity of the same wildlife individual while following motion and scene instructions, we construct a fixed wildlife generation benchmark from WildlifeVid. The benchmark covers 10 species, with 10 identities per species. For each identity, we select 1 reference image and pair it with 2 text prompts, resulting in 200 generation cases in total. All benchmark identities and their associated clips are excluded from WildlifeVid fine-tuning. All methods are evaluated on this fixed benchmark under identical output resolution and video duration.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 为了评估生成器在遵循运动和场景指令的同时，能否保留同一野生动物个体的身份特征，我们从 WildlifeVid 构建了一个固定的野生动物生成基准测试。 该基准测试涵盖 10 个物种，每个物种包含 10 个个体身份。 对于每个个体身份，我们选择 1 张参考图像，并将其与 2 个文本提示配对，总共形成 200 个生成案例。 所有基准测试中的个体身份及其相关的视频片段均未用于 WildlifeVid 的微调。 所有方法都在相同的输出分辨率和视频时长下，基于这一固定基准进行测试评估。

paragraphs.en: Quantitative Results. As shown in Table 1 , WildIcon achieves the best overall performance on our fixed wildlife generation benchmark. Compared with representative general-purpose I2V baselines and prior subject- or identity-consistent generation methods, our model delivers the clearest gains on identity preservation, improving Subject Consistency from 91.02% to 92.94%. These results suggest that WildIcon better preserves identity-critical wildlife appearance cues throughout the generated video while maintaining stable scene coherence and smooth temporal dynamics. Notably, these gains are achieved without sacrificing text relevance or motion quality, showing that stronger reference-conditioned appearance consistency remains compatible with the general generation capability of the pretrained I2V backbone.

paragraphs.en: Challenging cases. Figure 5 further illustrates several challenging cases under incomplete or ambiguous reference evidence. For the nyala, its tail overlaps with another individual’s head in the reference image, causing the overlap to be partially carried into the generated sequence. For the stoat and cat, vegetation obscures parts of the face; when the generated motion reveals regions that are not clearly visible in the reference, local appearance may drift, and unsupported details can emerge, such as the collar-like artifact in the cat example. For the tiger, thin fence wires crossing the animal are initially retained in the foreground, likely because these high-frequency structures are spatially entangled with the animal in the reference image. As the animal moves away from their original image locations, these artifacts gradually weaken. Overall, these examples show that generation is most reliable when the reference provides clear identity evidence and the requested motion does not require substantial extrapolation of unseen identity-bearing regions.

paragraphs.en: To further validate WildIcon, we evaluate on animal ReID, a fine-grained retrieval task for matching the same individual across different images. This experiment tests whether videos synthesized by different generators can provide useful training samples for downstream individual-level recognition. We use mean Average Precision (mAP) [ 59 ] and Cumulative Matching Characteristics (CMC) [ 32 ] as evaluation metrics. mAP measures overall retrieval performance by averaging precision across all query samples in the query set, while CMC measures the proportion of queries for which the correct identity appears within the top- k k retrieved results. We report mAP and CMC at Rank-1 ( % \% ), averaged over 10 runs, and provide the corresponding 95% confidence intervals in the Appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步验证 WildIcon，我们在动物 ReID 任务上进行了评估，这是一项细粒度检索任务，旨在匹配不同图像中的同一个体。 该实验旨在检验由不同生成器合成的视频能否为下游的个体级识别提供有用的训练样本。 我们使用平均精度（mAP）[59] 和累积匹配特征（CMC）[32] 作为评估指标。mAP 通过计算查询集中所有查询样本的平均精度来衡量整体检索性能，而 CMC 则衡量在检索结果的前 k 个结果中出现正确身份的查询比例。 我们报告了 Rank-1 下的 mAP 和 CMC（%），结果基于 10 次运行取平均值，并在附录中提供了相应的 95% 置信区间。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation follows a fixed synthetic-data construction pipeline. Starting from a curated real training subset, we use different I2V generators to synthesize videos under the same reference images and prompts, and then sample frames from the generated videos as synthetic training candidates. Each candidate is compared with its source reference image using a fixed DINO-based similarity filter, and only high-similarity samples are retained. We further apply a per-identity balanced selection rule to prevent synthetic samples from amplifying identity imbalance. This design supports two controlled comparisons. (1) To examine whether performance gains arise merely from increased data volume or from the additional supervision provided by reference-consistent generated samples, we include a classical data augmentation baseline with the same additional-sample budget. (2) To assess whether the generated data provides generally useful supervision, we evaluate all training sets with multiple ReID backbones, including SigLIP-FT [ 69 ] , DINO-FT [ 48 ] , and CLIP-ReID [ 24 ] . All remaining factors are held constant across generators, including the reference-image subset, prompt set, frame-extraction schedule, similarity-filtering rule, synthetic-data budget, ReID training setup, and the unchanged real-only query/gallery split.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估遵循一条固定的合成数据构建流程。 从一个经过筛选的真实训练子集开始，我们使用不同的 I2V 生成器，在相同的参考图像和提示下合成视频，然后从生成的视频中采样帧作为合成训练候选样本。 每个候选样本都通过一个基于 DINO 的固定相似性过滤器与对应的源参考图像进行比较，仅保留高相似性的样本。 我们进一步应用了按身份平衡的选择规则，以防止合成样本加剧身份不平衡问题。 这种设计支持两种受控比较。 (1) 为了检验性能提升究竟是单纯源于数据量的增加，还是来自参考图像一致的生成样本所提供的额外监督，我们加入了一个经典的数据增强基线模型，其额外样本预算与当前方案相同。 (2) 为了评估生成数据是否提供了普遍有用的监督信息，我们对所有训练集进行了多种 ReID 骨干网络的测试，包括 SigLIP-FT [ 69 ]、DINO-FT [ 48 ] 和 CLIP-ReID [ 24 ]。 在所有生成器中，其余因素均保持恒定，包括参考图像子集、提示集合、帧提取计划、相似性过滤规则、合成数据预算、ReID 训练配置，以及未改变的真实数据查询/图库划分。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 3 , adding synthetic data consistently improves ReID performance over the real-only setting across all backbones. In contrast, classical data augmentation provides only marginal and less stable gains, indicating that the improvement is not simply caused by increasing the number of training images. Under the same synthetic-data budget, samples generated by WildIcon outperform those generated by Wan2.2 across the evaluated ReID models, indicating that downstream improvements are primarily driven by the quality of identity preservation in generated samples rather than by the presence of synthetic data itself. Moreover, consistent improvements across different ReID architectures show that WildIcon provides reusable supervisory signals, supporting individual-consistent I2V generation as a practical data enrichment strategy for animal ReID. A generated-to-real retrieval evaluation further shows that WildIcon outperforms both Wan2.2 and WildlifeVid LoRA fine-tuning across all five datasets, while replacing DINOv3 with SigLIP for synthetic-sample selection preserves the downstream advantage (Appendix B.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 如表 3 所示，在所有骨干网络中，添加合成数据相较于仅使用真实数据的设置，能持续提升 ReID 性能。 相比之下，传统的数据增强方法仅带来微小且稳定性较差的提升，这表明性能提升并非单纯由训练图像数量的增加所导致。 在相同的合成数据预算下，WildIcon 生成的样本在所有评估的 ReID 模型中均优于 Wan2.2 生成的样本，这表明下游任务的提升主要源于生成样本在身份保持方面的质量，而非合成数据本身的存在。 此外，不同 ReID 架构中一致的性能提升表明，WildIcon 提供了可重复使用的监督信号，支持个体一致性 I2V 生成，从而成为动物 ReID 领域一种实用的数据增强策略。 进一步的生成样本到真实样本的检索评估显示，WildIcon 在全部五个数据集上的表现均优于 Wan2.2 和 WildlifeVid LoRA 微调方法；同时，将合成样本选择中的 DINOv3 替换为 SigLIP 后，其下游任务优势依然得以保留（附录 B.4）。

sents.en: Moreover, consistent improvements across different ReID architectures show that WildIcon provides reusable supervisory signals, supporting individual-consistent I2V generation as a practical data enrichment strategy for animal ReID.
sents.zh: 此外，不同 ReID 架构中一致的性能提升表明，WildIcon 提供了可重复使用的监督信号，支持个体一致性 I2V 生成，从而成为动物 ReID 领域一种实用的数据增强策略。

sents.en: A generated-to-real retrieval evaluation further shows that WildIcon outperforms both Wan2.2 and WildlifeVid LoRA fine-tuning across all five datasets, while replacing DINOv3 with SigLIP for synthetic-sample selection preserves the downstream advantage (Appendix B.4 ).
sents.zh: 进一步的生成样本到真实样本的检索评估显示，WildIcon 在全部五个数据集上的表现均优于 Wan2.2 和 WildlifeVid LoRA 微调方法；同时，将合成样本选择中的 DINOv3 替换为 SigLIP 后，其下游任务优势依然得以保留（附录 B.4）。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we explored individual-consistent I2V generation for wildlife as a practical direction for mitigating the data scarcity that limits wildlife identification. To support this task, we proposed WildlifeVid, a wildlife-centric video dataset with individual-level identity labels for training and evaluating individual-consistent I2V models. We further proposed WildIcon, a frequency-aware I2V framework that uses foreground-filtered high-frequency cues to better maintain identity-relevant appearance supported by the reference image. Experiments showed that WildIcon achieves stronger identity consistency than existing baselines, and that its generated samples consistently improve downstream animal ReID across five species. These results suggest that individual-consistent wildlife I2V generation can serve as a practical tool for enriching training data for wildlife identification and supporting broader biodiversity monitoring efforts when real observations are limited.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们将个体一致性 I2V 生成应用于野生动物领域，以此作为缓解数据稀缺问题（该问题限制了野生动物识别）的一种实用方向。 为支持这一任务，我们提出了 WildlifeVid——一个以野生动物为中心的视频数据集，其中包含用于训练和评估个体一致性 I2V 模型的个体级身份标签。 我们进一步提出了 WildIcon——一个频率感知的 I2V 框架，它利用经过前景过滤的高频线索，在参考图像的支持下更好地保留与身份相关的外观特征。 实验表明，WildIcon 在身份一致性方面优于现有基线模型，且其生成的样本能持续提升五个物种的动物再识别（ReID）性能。 这些结果表明，当实际观测数据有限时，个体一致的野生动物 I2V 生成可以作为一种实用工具，用于丰富野生动物识别的训练数据，并支持更广泛生物多样性监测工作。

paragraphs.en: WildlifeVid is constructed by curating and re-annotating clips from existing wildlife video resources, including videos hosted on public platforms where applicable. paragraphs.en: Animal-centric preprocessing. All real training, query, gallery, and synthetic-filtering inputs are processed as animal-centric crops using the same detection and preprocessing pipeline. The similarity used for synthetic-sample filtering is computed between the animal crop of each generated frame and the corresponding animal crop of its real reference image, rather than between full-scene images. This reduces the influence of background and scene context in both synthetic-sample selection and downstream ReID evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 以动物为中心的预处理。 所有真实的训练、查询、图库和合成过滤输入，均通过相同的检测与预处理流程，处理为以动物为中心的裁剪图像。 用于合成样本过滤的相似性，是每帧生成图像的动物裁剪部分与其真实参考图像中对应的动物裁剪部分之间的计算结果，而非完整场景图像之间的计算结果。 这减少了背景与场景上下文在合成样本选择及后续 ReID 评估中的影响。

paragraphs.en: Reference image selection. To prevent test-set leakage, reference images are selected from only the real training split of each ReID dataset. Let 𝒟 i train \mathcal{D}^{\mathrm{train}}_{i} denote the real training images of identity i i . We construct a reference pool ℛ i ⊆ 𝒟 i train \mathcal{R}_{i}\subseteq\mathcal{D}^{\mathrm{train}}_{i} by excluding images that are unsuitable as I2V references, such as severely blurred, low-visibility nighttime, or infrared images with weak visible identity cues. This filtering is applied only to the reference pool for video generation; the original real, query, and gallery splits remain unchanged. The same reference pool is used for all compared generation methods.
paragraphs.zh: 参考图像选择。 为防止测试集泄露，参考图像仅从每个 ReID 数据集的真实训练子集中选取。 令 𝒟 i train \mathcal{D}^{\mathrm{train}}_{i} 表示身份 i 的真实训练图像。 我们通过排除不适合作为 I2V 参考的图像（例如严重模糊、夜间低可见度或可见身份特征较弱的红外图像）来构建参考池 ℛ i ⊆ 𝒟 i train \mathcal{R}_{i}\subseteq\mathcal{D}^{\mathrm{train}}_{i}。 此筛选仅应用于视频生成的参考池；原始的真实、查询和图库子集保持不变。 所有对比的生成方法均使用相同的参考池。

paragraphs.en: Reference-evidence admission guardrail. For downstream ReID augmentation, we restrict generation to motion and viewpoint changes that remain supported by the visual evidence in the reference image. Prompts requiring a full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} rotation, explicit exposure of the opposite side, or a camera orbit around the animal are excluded because they may reveal identity-bearing regions that are not observed in the reference. Under the same reference images and prompts, existing video generators often produce plausible motion but exhibit identity-cue drift, including blurred stripe or spot boundaries, shifted fur texture, altered local markings, and inconsistent body contours. paragraphs.en: First, the identity-branch input ablation shows that directly using the full reference image provides only limited gains over Wan2.2-A14B. This suggests that raw reference-image conditioning may introduce background clutter and non-identity visual details that are not useful for preserving wildlife identity. In contrast, foreground-only conditioning improves both identity preservation and video realism by suppressing background interference. High-frequency-only conditioning yields slightly stronger subject consistency than foreground-only conditioning, indicating that local residual cues are useful for maintaining identity-sensitive texture and boundary details. However, it performs worse than the full WildIcon setting, because high-frequency residuals alone discard semantic foreground context and spatial support. The full WildIcon identity branch achieves the best overall results by combining foreground appearance with foreground-filtered high-frequency cues, confirming that these two sources provide complementary identity evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，身份分支输入消融实验表明，直接使用完整参考图像相较于 Wan2.2-A14B 仅能带来有限的性能提升。 这表明，直接以原始参考图像作为条件输入可能会引入背景杂讯和与身份无关的视觉细节，而这些细节对保留野生动物身份并无帮助。 相比之下，仅以前景为条件的输入通过抑制背景干扰，同时提升了身份保留度和视频的真实感。 仅以高频信息为条件的输入在主体一致性方面略优于仅以前景为条件的输入，说明局部残留特征有助于维持与身份相关的纹理和边界细节。 然而，其表现不如完整的 WildIcon 设置，因为仅使用高频残留特征会丢弃语义前景上下文和空间支撑信息。 完整的 WildIcon 身份分支通过结合前景外观与经过前景过滤的高频特征，实现了最佳的整体效果，证实了这两种特征来源提供了互补的身份识别依据。

paragraphs.en: Second, the injection-strategy ablation shows that injecting identity conditioning into early blocks or all blocks is less effective than the default middle-to-late strategy. Early-block injection improves background consistency but provides weaker subject consistency, suggesting that introducing identity cues too early may interfere with coarse layout and motion formation. All-block injection improves FVD compared with early-only injection, but it reduces motion smoothness and text relevance, indicating that overly persistent identity conditioning can constrain prompt-driven generation. paragraphs.en: Qualitative ablation studies of WildIcon. Figure 8 provides qualitative evidence for the ablation results in Table 5 . The red boxes highlight representative local failures caused by removing or misplacing key components of WildIcon. With foreground-only conditioning, the model preserves the coarse body appearance but still produces localized identity drift, such as tail deformation in later frames. With high-frequency-only conditioning, local residual cues are available, but the lack of foreground semantic context leads to unstable appearance, including abnormal whitening and texture drift on the back. Injecting identity tokens only into early blocks disrupts temporal formation, leading to less coherent motion and more noticeable changes in head appearance across frames. Injecting identity conditioning into all blocks can over-constrain the generation process and introduce structural artifacts, such as distorted legs and feet. In contrast, the full WildIcon model preserves the nyala’s stripe patterns, body contour, head appearance, and limb structure more consistently across the generated frames.

paragraphs.en: Direct generated-to-real retrieval. paragraphs.en: We replace the DINOv3 selection representation with a frozen SigLIP encoder. Both representations operate on the same generated candidate pool and animal-centric crops. paragraphs.en: WildlifeVid is constructed by curating and re-annotating clips from four publicly accessible wildlife video sources, including Animal-in-Motion (AiM) [ Zhao et al., 2025a ] , AnimalKingdom [ Ng et al., 2022 ] , MammalNet [ Chen et al., 2023 ] , and LoTE-Animal [ Liu et al., 2023 ] . These sources provide broad coverage of wildlife appearance, behavior, viewpoint, and environmental variation, but their original annotations are not sufficient for individual-consistent I2V training and evalutation. In particular, they are designed for tasks such as animal reconstruction, species recognition, action understanding, behavior analysis, and pose estimation, rather than individual-identity modeling. We therefore use these datasets as candidate video sources and apply a unified curation and re-annotation pipeline to obtain training-ready WildlifeVid clips.
paragraphs.zh: WildlifeVid 是通过整理和重新标注来自四个公开可用的野生动物视频来源的片段构建而成的，包括 Animal-in-Motion (AiM) [ Zhao et al., 2025a ]、AnimalKingdom [ Ng et al., 2022 ]、MammalNet [ Chen et al., 2023 ] 和 LoTE-Animal [ Liu et al., 2023 ]。 这些来源广泛覆盖了野生动物的外观、行为、视角和环境变化，但其原始标注不足以支持针对个体一致性 I2V 的训练与评估。 具体而言，这些数据集是为动物重建、物种识别、动作理解、行为分析和姿态估计等任务设计的，而非用于个体身份建模。 因此，我们将这些数据集用作候选视频来源，并应用统一的整理与重新标注流程，以获得可用于训练的 WildlifeVid 片段。

paragraphs.en: AiM is a web-scale resource for 4D animal reconstruction, converting videos into object-centric clips with auxiliary annotations, such as masks, keypoints, and depth. The AiM benchmark contains 30K videos and 2M frames. AnimalKingdom is a large and diverse benchmark spanning 850 species across six major animal classes, with annotations for video grounding, fine-grained action recognition, and pose estimation. MammalNet contains over 18K videos totaling 539 hours, covering 173 mammal categories and 12 high-level behaviors; and LoTE-Animal focuses on understanding the behavior of endangered animals, with 10K annotated video sequences and 28K images collected over 12 years from 11 endangered species.
paragraphs.zh: AiM 是一个面向网络规模的资源，用于 4D 动物重建，可将视频转换为以物体为中心的视频片段，并附带辅助标注，例如掩码、关键点和深度信息。 AiM 基准数据集包含 3 万条视频和 200 万帧图像。 AnimalKingdom 是一个规模庞大且多样化的基准数据集，涵盖六大动物类群中的 850 个物种，并提供了视频定位、细粒度动作识别和姿态估计的标注信息。 MammalNet 包含超过 1.8 万条视频，总时长达 539 小时，覆盖 173 种哺乳动物类别和 12 种高级行为；而 LoTE-Animal 则专注于理解濒危动物的行为，其数据包括 1 万条标注视频序列和 2.8 万张图像，这些素材在 12 年间从 11 种濒危物种中收集而来。

paragraphs.en: Shot splitting. Raw wildlife videos may contain shot changes, abrupt camera transitions, or multiple temporal segments with different visible individuals. We first split each source video into candidate clips with PySceneDetect [ Castellano, 2026 ] , which detects large values of weighted average pixel change across frames. To avoid over-segmentation caused by brief visual fluctuations, we merge very short adjacent segments during shot splitting. This setting is used only to stabilize shot-boundary detection and does not impose a fixed duration threshold on the final retained clips. After this step, each candidate clip is further checked for species presence, single-subject visibility, and temporal identity consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 镜头分割。 原始野生动物视频可能包含镜头切换、突兀的相机转换，或具有不同可见个体的多个时间片段。 我们首先使用 PySceneDetect [ Castellano, 2026 ] 将每个源视频分割为候选剪辑，该工具可检测帧间加权平均像素变化的大值。 为避免由短暂视觉波动引起的过度分割，我们在镜头分割过程中会合并非常短的相邻片段。 此设置仅用于稳定镜头边界检测，并不会对最终保留的剪辑施加固定的时长阈值。 在此步骤之后，每个候选剪辑还会进一步检查物种存在性、单一主体的可见性以及时间身份一致性。

paragraphs.en: Single-subject enforcement. Since WildlifeVid is designed for individual-consistent I2V generation, each retained clip should contain one dominant wildlife individual without identity changes. To enforce this constraint, we use a Grounded-SAM2 tracking pipeline, where GroundingDINO-Tiny initializes text-grounded wildlife detections and SAM2 Hiera Large predicts and propagates instance masks over time. Bounding boxes are derived from the predicted instance masks. In our implementation, videos are resampled to 10 10 fps, new text-grounded detections are introduced every 50 50 frames, and the detection thresholds are set to box_threshold=0.6 and text_threshold=0.3. Very small detections are removed based on the mask-derived bounding-box area to suppress unreliable distant or spurious subjects. A candidate clip is rejected if any checked frame contains no valid wildlife instance or more than one valid wildlife instance.
paragraphs.zh: 单一主体约束。 由于 WildlifeVid 专为保持个体一致性的 I2V 生成而设计，因此每个保留的片段应包含一个主导的野生动物个体，且身份不得发生变化。 为强制执行此约束，我们使用 Grounded-SAM2 跟踪流程：其中 GroundingDINO-Tiny 负责初始化基于文本的野生动物检测，而 SAM2 Hiera Large 则预测并随时间传播实例掩码。 边界框由预测出的实例掩码生成。 在我们的实现中，视频被重新采样至 10 帧/秒，每 50 帧引入一次新的基于文本的检测结果，检测阈值设为 box_threshold=0.6 和 text_threshold=0.3。 基于掩码生成的边界框面积，会移除极小的检测结果，以抑制不可靠的远距离或虚假主体。 如果任意一个已检查的帧中既没有有效的野生动物实例，或存在多个有效野生动物实例，则该候选片段将被拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Visibility and temporal stability filtering. After single-subject enforcement, we further refine the remaining clips to ensure reliable identity supervision. To remove unstable tracks, we compute the Intersection over Union (IoU) between bounding boxes in adjacent checked frames. If the IoU of any adjacent checked-frame pair falls below 0.5 0.5 , the whole track is removed, since such cases usually indicate missed detections, tracking failure, abrupt shot changes, or possible identity switches. We also remove tracks in which the animal is heavily truncated by the image boundary. Specifically, if the mask-derived bounding box lies within 3 3 pixels of any image boundary in any checked frame, the corresponding track is discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 可见性与时间稳定性过滤。 在完成单主体执行后，我们进一步对剩余的片段进行优化，以确保身份识别的可靠性。 为了移除不稳定的轨迹，我们计算相邻已检查帧中边界框之间的交并比（IoU）。 如果任意相邻已检查帧对的 IoU 低于 0.5，则整个轨迹将被移除，因为这类情况通常表示检测遗漏、跟踪失败、突然的镜头切换或可能的身份切换。 我们还会移除动物被图像边界严重截断的轨迹。 具体来说，如果由掩码生成的边界框在任何已检查帧中距离图像边界小于 3 像素，则对应的轨迹将被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Prompt generation and cleaning. Text prompts provide controllable conditions for WildlifeVid clips, including the visible species, motion, viewpoint, and scene context. For each retained clip, we sample representative frames over its duration and query GPT-5 [ OpenAI, 2025 ] with an instruction to describe only visible content in the sampled frames. The instruction template used for this step is shown in Figure 12 . Since raw captions may contain generic template phrases, unsupported behavioral interpretations, repeated descriptions, or details unrelated to the target animal, we further clean them into standardized training prompts. Specifically, we remove non-visual or speculative content, such as inferred intent, emotion, causal explanations, or attributes that are not clearly visible in the sampled frames. We also remove irrelevant background descriptions when they do not affect the target animal or the requested motion. The final prompt is a concise factual sentence describing the visible animal, its motion, viewpoint, and scene context, e.g. , “a tiger walks slowly through grass in a side view”.
paragraphs.zh: 提示生成与清理。 文本提示为 WildlifeVid 片段提供可控的条件，包括可见物种、动作、视角和场景背景。 对于每个保留的片段，我们会在其持续时间内采样代表性帧，并使用指令向 GPT-5 [ OpenAI, 2025 ] 查询，要求仅描述采样帧中可见的内容。 此步骤使用的指令模板如第 12 图所示。 由于原始字幕可能包含通用模板短语、不支持的行为解读、重复描述或与目标动物无关的细节，我们进一步将其清理为标准化的训练提示。 具体而言，我们会移除非视觉性或推测性内容，例如推断出的意图、情绪、因果解释或采样帧中未明确可见的属性。 当无关的背景描述不影响目标动物或所请求的动作时，我们也会将其移除。 最终提示是一个简洁的事实性句子，描述了可见的动物、其动作、视角和场景背景，例如：“一只老虎以侧视角度在草丛中缓慢行走”。

paragraphs.en: Identity Annotation Details WildlifeVid assigns identity labels at the clip level. After curation, each retained track is first treated as a candidate identity unit. To associate clips that contain the same individual, we perform within-species candidate grouping using visual embeddings. For each retained clip, we use the temporal midpoint frame as the representative image and extract an appearance embedding with a frozen DINOv3 ViT-H/16+ model [ Siméoni et al., 2025 ] . All embeddings are ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized before similarity computation. Within each species, we perform average-linkage agglomerative clustering in cosine space with a distance threshold of 0.15 0.15 , corresponding approximately to candidate cross-clip merges with cosine similarity at least 0.85 0.85 .
paragraphs.zh: 身份标注详情：WildlifeVid 在剪辑层级分配身份标签。 经过筛选后，每条保留的轨迹首先被视作一个候选身份单元。 为了将包含同一个体的剪辑关联起来，我们利用视觉嵌入进行物种内部的候选分组。 对于每条保留的剪辑，我们以时间中点帧作为代表图像，并使用冻结的 DINOv3 ViT-H/16+ 模型提取外观嵌入 [ Siméoni et al., 2025 ]。 在计算相似度之前，所有嵌入都经过 ℓ₂ 归一化。 在每个物种内部，我们在余弦空间中执行平均连接凝聚聚类，距离阈值为 0.15，这大致对应于余弦相似度至少为 0.85 的剪辑间候选合并。

paragraphs.en: High-similarity candidate merges are then manually reviewed. Annotators compare stable individual-specific appearance cues, including stripe topology, spot configuration, facial patches, horn shape, tail markings, contour details, and other persistent coat-pattern cues when applicable. A merge is accepted only when all the annotators agree that the clips contain the same individual; otherwise, the candidate is rejected. Accepted clips are assigned the same identity label, while rejected candidates retain their own identities.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，高相似性的候选合并结果会经过人工审核。 标注员会对比稳定的个体特异性外观特征，包括条纹拓扑结构、斑点分布、面部斑纹、角形、尾部标记、轮廓细节以及适用情况下的其他持久性皮毛图案特征。 只有当所有标注员一致认为这些片段包含同一个体时，该合并结果才会被接受；否则，该候选结果将被拒绝。 被接受的片段会被赋予相同的身份标签，而被拒绝的候选结果则保留各自原有的身份。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate all models on a fixed wildlife I2V benchmark constructed from WildlifeVid. Benchmark identities are drawn from all four source datasets used to build WildlifeVid [ Zhao et al., 2025a , Ng et al., 2022 , Chen et al., 2023 , Liu et al., 2023 ] . The benchmark contains 10 species and 100 identities in total, with 10 identities per species. For every identity, we select one reference image and pair it with two prompts, resulting in 200 generation cases overall. Thus, each generation case is defined as a tuple of (species, identity, reference image, prompt) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个基于 WildlifeVid 构建的固定野生动物 I2V 基准数据集上评估所有模型。 基准数据集的身份信息来自构建 WildlifeVid 时使用的全部四个源数据集 [ Zhao et al., 2025a , Ng et al., 2022 , Chen et al., 2023 , Liu et al., 2023 ] 。 该基准数据集共包含 10 个物种和 100 个身份，每个物种有 10 个身份。 对于每个身份，我们选择一张参考图像，并将其与两个提示词配对，总共生成 200 个生成案例。 因此，每个生成案例被定义为一个元组：(物种, 身份, 参考图像, 提示词) 。

paragraphs.en: Prompt design. Each identity is paired with two prompts to evaluate identity preservation under different levels of motion and appearance variation. Prompt A contains mild motion and limited viewpoint change, such as slow forward movement, gentle body motion, or a slight head turn. Prompt B is more challenging and introduces stronger pose or viewpoint variation, such as turning around, body rotation, or larger camera movement.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词设计。 每个身份都搭配两个提示词，以评估在不同程度运动和外观变化下身份的保留情况。 提示词 A 包含轻微的运动和有限的视角变化，例如缓慢的前进、轻柔的身体动作或轻微的头部转动。 提示词 B 更具挑战性，引入了更强的姿态或视角变化，例如转身、身体旋转或更大的相机移动。

paragraphs.en: Data splits and fixed evaluation protocol. The benchmark is kept fixed throughout all model comparisons and ablation studies. To avoid identity leakage between training and evaluation, all benchmark identities are excluded from the WildlifeVid training split, and the model is trained only on the remaining identities. All compared methods are evaluated using the same reference images, prompts, output resolution, and video duration.
paragraphs.zh: 数据划分与固定的评估协议。 在所有模型对比和消融研究中，基准均保持固定不变。 为避免训练与评估之间出现身份泄露，所有基准身份均被排除在 WildlifeVid 训练数据划分之外，模型仅基于剩余身份进行训练。 所有对比方法均使用相同的参考图像、提示词、输出分辨率和视频时长进行评估。

paragraphs.en: This work focuses on a controlled, individual-consistent I2V setting in which the reference image contains a known wildlife individual, and the generated video is expected to preserve that individual’s appearance across new poses, viewpoints, and motions. Consistent with this formulation, WildlifeVid prioritizes single-subject, temporally coherent clips so that identity labels, prompts, and evaluation targets are well defined. This design makes the benchmark suitable for studying individual-level identity preservation. In contrast, broader full-scene wildlife generation involving multiple interacting animals, dense occlusion, or ambiguous identity association remains a complementary direction.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作聚焦于一种受控且个体一致性的 I2V 设置，其中参考图像包含一个已知的野生动物个体，而生成的视频则需要在新的姿势、视角和动作中保留该个体的外观。 与此设定一致，WildlifeVid 优先选择单主体且时间上连贯的片段，以确保身份标签、提示词和评估目标都清晰明确。 这种设计使该基准测试适用于研究个体层面的身份保持问题。 相比之下，涉及多个互动动物、密集遮挡或身份关联模糊的更广泛全场景野生动物生成，仍是一个补充性的研究方向。

paragraphs.en: WildIcon operates in a single-reference setting and therefore cannot create new ground-truth identity evidence beyond what is supported by the conditioning image. When generation requires substantial viewpoint changes, particularly exposure of identity-bearing regions that are not visible in the reference, the model may extrapolate or hallucinate local markings, textures, or contours. Accordingly, individual consistency in this work refers to maintaining identity-relevant appearance supported by the reference image, rather than recovering verified appearance on unseen surfaces. Generated videos should therefore be treated as synthetic training candidates, not as genuine wildlife observations, ecological records, retrieval-database entries, or substitutes for real identity evidence.
paragraphs.zh: WildIcon 在单参考设置下运行，因此无法创建超出条件图像所支持范围的新身份基准证据。 当生成需要大幅改变视角时，尤其是暴露参考图像中不可见的身份特征区域时，模型可能会外推或虚构局部标记、纹理或轮廓。 因此，本研究中的个体一致性指的是维持参考图像所支持的身份相关外观，而非在未见表面上恢复已验证的外观。 因此，生成的视频应被视为合成训练候选样本，而非真实的野生动物观察、生态记录、检索数据库条目或真实身份证据的替代品。

paragraphs.en: WildIcon also depends on the visual evidence available in the reference image. The method is applicable when individual-discriminative cues, such as fur texture, stripe boundaries, spot configurations, or contour transitions, are visible in the input. When the reference image is extremely low-resolution, strongly blurred, heavily occluded, captured under very poor lighting, or depicts species with weak external individual markings, the available identity-conditioning signal is inherently limited.
paragraphs.zh: WildIcon 也依赖于参考图像中可用的视觉证据。 当输入图像中可见个体区分特征（例如毛发纹理、条纹边界、斑点分布或轮廓过渡）时，该方法即可适用。 如果参考图像的分辨率极低、严重模糊、被大量遮挡、在极差光照条件下拍摄，或描绘的是外部个体标记不明显的物种，那么可用于身份识别的条件信号本身就会受到限制。

paragraphs.en: Societal Impacts. WildIcon and WildlifeVid are developed to support data-scarce wildlife identification. The potential positive impact of WildIcon lies in using filtered generated samples as candidate training augmentations when real observations are limited. These samples can expose ReID models to additional appearance and motion variation during training, but they do not constitute additional field observations or new ground-truth identity evidence. Improved ReID models may in turn support wildlife monitoring workflows, while ecological inference and validation should continue to rely on real observations.
paragraphs.zh: 社会影响。 WildIcon 和 WildlifeVid 的开发旨在支持数据稀缺情况下的野生动物识别。 WildIcon 潜在的积极影响在于，当实际观测有限时，可将经过筛选的生成样本用作候选训练增强数据。 这些样本可以在训练过程中使 ReID 模型接触到更多外观和动作变化，但它们并不构成额外的实地观测或新的真实身份证据。 改进后的 ReID 模型反过来可能支持野生动物监测流程，但生态推断与验证仍需依赖实际观测。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, the proposed technology may have unintended negative impacts. First, synthetic wildlife videos could be misused to fabricate evidence of animal sightings, population presence, or conservation outcomes. Such misuse may be especially harmful when generated media are presented without clear disclosure. Second, because the generated videos are synthetic observations rather than field-captured evidence, they should not be used directly to support ecological claims, such as confirming the presence, absence, movement, or population size of a species. Their intended role is to support model training and controlled evaluation, not to replace real observations or expert ecological assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 同时，所提出的技术可能会产生意想不到的负面影响。 首先，合成野生动物视频可能被滥用，用于伪造动物目击、种群存在或保护成果的证据。 当生成的媒体内容未经明确披露时，这种滥用可能尤其有害。 其次，由于这些生成的视频是合成观察结果，而非实地拍摄的证据，因此不应直接用于支持生态主张，例如确认某种物种的存在、不存在、活动范围或种群规模。 它们的设计用途是支持模型训练和受控评估，而不是替代真实观察或专家的生态评估。

paragraphs.en: Safeguards and Responsible Release. We take several safeguards for responsible release. The dataset, WildlifeVid, is constructed from publicly accessible wildlife video sources and further curated into single-subject, temporally stable clips with prompts and individual-level identity labels. We release only the curated wildlife-centric data and associated annotations permitted by the corresponding source terms. We avoid releasing sensitive ecological metadata, such as precise camera locations, deployment identifiers, or fine-grained timestamps, when such information could increase the risk of unauthorized tracking or disturbance of wildlife.
paragraphs.zh: 保障措施与负责任发布。 我们采取了多项保障措施以确保负责任地发布数据。 WildlifeVid 数据集由公开可获取的野生动物视频源构建，并进一步整理为包含提示词和个体身份标签的单对象、时间稳定的片段。 我们仅发布经过整理的以野生动物为核心的数据以及相应来源条款所允许的相关标注信息。 当敏感生态元数据（如精确的摄像头位置、部署标识符或精细的时间戳）可能增加未经授权追踪或干扰野生动物的风险时，我们避免发布此类信息。

paragraphs.en: For generated content, all synthetic videos released with the paper are labeled as synthetic and are intended for research, model evaluation, and downstream ReID training rather than as ecological evidence. We do not encourage the use of generated videos to support claims about real animal sightings, population presence, or conservation outcomes. Any released model weights, code, or generation examples will be accompanied by usage guidelines that prohibit presenting synthetic wildlife videos as real camera-trap footage or using the model to fabricate ecological evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 对于生成的内容，随论文发布的所有合成视频均被标注为合成内容，其用途仅限于研究、模型评估以及下游 ReID 训练，而非作为生态证据。 我们不鼓励使用生成的视频来支持有关真实动物目击、种群存在或保护成果的主张。 任何发布的模型权重、代码或生成示例都将附带使用指南，禁止将合成野生动物视频呈现为真实的相机陷阱影像，或使用该模型捏造生态证据。
